<!-- remark-1: body_md -->
Current entropy conserving two-point fluxes for multi-species \cite{gouasmi2020contributions,renac2021entropy,peyvan2023high,ching2024positivity, badrkhani2026entropy} are not kinetic energy preserving\\
<!-- end remark-1 -->
<!-- remark-2: body_md -->
The current option for a kinetic energy preserving two-point flux for multi-species, ie. the Pirozzoli flux \cite{keeton2025discontinuous}, is not entropy conserving.\\
<!-- end remark-2 -->
